[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Ysa'i''' was a golden-furred [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] orthopedist who specialized in the treatment of his own [[Species/Legends|species]]. Ysa'i was one of the doctors who helped care for [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]] after an [[Attempted assassination of Admiral Nek Bwua'tu|assassination attempt]] on the Admiral left him in a [[Coma/Legends|coma]].
